```{r}
library(Maaslin2)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
load("qiime_f.RData")

#TO determine change before and after antibiotics in CDI expt. Group by phylum
cdi_s_p <- qiime_f %>% tax_glom(taxrank="Phylum")

otu_table <- as.data.frame(otu_table(cdi_s_p))
otu_table<-otu_table[rowSums(otu_table) >= 1, ]

otu_table_df<-as.data.frame(otu_table)
otu_table_df<-rownames_to_column(otu_table_df,"ASV")

TT = tax_table(cdi_s_p)
TT = TT[, which(apply(!apply(TT, 2, is.na), 2, any))]
tdf_maa = data.frame(TT, OTU = taxa_names(cdi_s_p))

tdf_maa$ASV <- rownames(tdf_maa)

pOTUtax = merge(otu_table_df, tdf_maa, by="ASV")
pOTUtax <- pOTUtax[pOTUtax$Genus != "Chloroplast", ]
pOTUtax <- pOTUtax[pOTUtax$Class != "Cyanobacteriia", ]
pOTUtax $TAX <- apply(pOTUtax [, c("Phylum", "Class", "Order","Family","Genus")], 1, function(x) paste(na.omit(x), collapse = ";"))


# Group by Family and sum up OTU counts
library(dplyr)
pOTUtax_fam_summed <- pOTUtax %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

pOTUtax_fam_summed<-na.omit(pOTUtax_fam_summed)
pOTUtax_family_input<-column_to_rownames(pOTUtax_fam_summed,"Phylum")
pOTUtax_family_input_filtered <- pOTUtax_family_input[rowSums(pOTUtax_family_input) >= 5, ]

# Save the summed table
write.table(pOTUtax_family_input_filtered, "OTU_table_log_summed_by_ASV.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)


df_input_metadata = read.table(file = "Young_aging_metadata_v4.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#df_input_metadata = read.table(file = "AMCohortC_lumu_meta_v2.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df_input_metadata = read.table(file = "CDI/CDIseverity_16S_meta.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract metadata

common_samples_maas <- intersect(rownames(df_input_metadata), colnames(pOTUtax_family_input_filtered))

# Subset OTU table to include only common samples
otu_table_filtered <- pOTUtax_family_input_filtered[, common_samples_maas]

otu_table_transposed <- t(otu_table_filtered)

# Subset metadata to include only common samples
df_input_metadata_fil <- df_input_metadata[common_samples_maas, ]

# Check the dimensions
dim(otu_table_transposed)
dim(df_input_metadata_fil)

otu_table_transposed<-data.frame(otu_table_transposed)
# Define the explanatory variables (covariates, treatments)
# For example, assuming "treatment" and "age" are explanatory variables in your metadata
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Run MaAsLin2
maaslin_results <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = otu_table_transposed,  # OTU table
  input_metadata = df_input_metadata_fil,  # Metadata table
  fixed_effects = c("month_n"),  # Fixed effects (e.g., treatment, age)
  output= "output_Phylum_monthN_random-cohort_ASV_LM_CLR_BH",
  plot_scatter = TRUE,
  reference = c("month_n","3"),random_effects = c("mousegroup.x"),
  normalization = "CLR",analysis_method = "LM"
)

set.seed(1)
fit_out <- maaslin3(input_data = otu_table_transposed,
                    input_metadata = df_input_metadata_fil,
                    output = 'Maaslin3_output',
                    formula = '~ month_n + (1|mouse) + (1|mousegroup.x)',
                    normalization = 'TSS',
                    transform = 'LOG',
                    augment = TRUE,
                    standardize = TRUE,
                    max_significance = 0.1,
                    median_comparison_abundance = TRUE,
                    median_comparison_prevalence = FALSE,
                    max_pngs = 250,
                    cores = 1)

```

```{r}
results<-read_excel("output_ASV_month_random-cohort_ASV_LM_CLR_BH/maaslin summary GI.xlsx")

results_tdf_maa<-merge(results,tdf_maa, by.x="feature", by.y = "ASV")

  mutate(logq = -log10(qval))

  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +

       y = expression(-log[10]("q-value")),
       title = "Volcano plot of MaAsLin2 analysis") +
```

```{r}
# Make a relative abundance plot of ASVs that vary with age that have a rel abund >0.1

## Add a column that says if coef is minus or plus, mergde with TAX name, and plot them separately in the figure

results_tdf_maa$coef_direction<- ifelse(results_tdf_maa$coef < 0, "minus", "plus")

results_tdf_maa$TAX2<-paste(results_tdf_maa$TAX,results_tdf_maa$coef_direction,sep="_")

otu_table_norm <- as.data.frame(otu_table(qiime_norm))
otu_table_norm$ASV<-rownames(otu_table_norm)
results_tdf_maa_rel_abund<-merge(results_tdf_maa, otu_table_norm,by.x="feature",by.y="ASV")

results_rel_abund <- results_tdf_maa_rel_abund %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TAX2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

results_rel_abund<-results_rel_abund[-c(2:8)]
results_rel_abund$SUM<-rowSums(results_rel_abund[, 2:624], na.rm = TRUE)
results_rel_abund$AVG <- results_rel_abund %>%
  dplyr::select(2:624) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  rowMeans(na.rm = TRUE)
results_rel_abund <- results_rel_abund %>%
  arrange(desc(AVG))

results_rel_abund_pt09 <- results_rel_abund %>% 
  slice(1:13)

results_rel_abund_pt09<- results_rel_abund_pt09[-c(625:626)]
otu_long <- results_rel_abund_pt09 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -TAX2,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )
otu_long2 <- otu_long %>%
  left_join(metadata_f, by = "sample")

tax2_month_median <- otu_long2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(month, TAX2) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(median_abund = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

okabe_ito <- c(
  "#E69F00", # orange
  "#56B4E9", # sky blue
  "#009E73", # bluish green
  "#F0E442", # yellow
  "#0072B2", # blue
  "#D55E00", # vermillion
  "#CC79A7", # reddish purple
  "#999999" # grey
)

ggplot(tax2_month_median, aes(x = factor(month), y = median_abund, fill = TAX2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Median Relative Abundance", fill = "Taxon (TAX2)") +
  theme_bw() +scale_fill_manual(values = pal18_okabeito)+

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

## Which ASVs change with sex regardless of age
```{r}
asv_sex<-read.delim("output_ASV_sex_random-cohort_ASV_LM_CLR_BH/significant_results.tsv")
View(asv_sex)
asv_sex<-merge(asv_sex,tdf_maa, by.x="feature",by.y ="ASV")
asv_sex_sig<-asv_sex %>%
  dplyr::filter(qval < 0.05)
asv_sex_sig_table<-merge(asv_sex_sig,otu_table_norm_tdf_maa,by.x="OTU", by.y="ASV")
asv_sex_sig_table$coeff <- ifelse(asv_sex_sig_table$coef < 0, "minus","plus")
asv_sex_sig_table<-asv_sex_sig_table[-c(2:17)]
asv_sex_sig_table$Family_coef<-paste(asv_sex_sig_table$Family.y,asv_sex_sig_table$coeff,sep="_")
asv_sex_sig_table$Genus_coef<-paste(asv_sex_sig_table$Genus.y,asv_sex_sig_table$coeff,sep="_")
asv_sex_sig_table<-asv_sex_sig_table[-c(625:634)]

asv_sex_sig_table_t<-t(asv_sex_sig_table)
asv_sex_sig_table_t<- asv_sex_sig_table_t %>%
  {colnames(.) <- as.character(unlist(.[1, ])); .[-1, ]}
asv_sex_sig_table_t<-as.data.frame(asv_sex_sig_table_t)
asv_sex_sig_table_t$SampleID <- rownames(asv_sex_sig_table_t)

categories <- as.character(asv_sex_sig_table_t[nrow(asv_sex_sig_table_t), ])
df_data <- asv_sex_sig_table_t[-nrow(asv_sex_sig_table_t), ]
df_list <- lapply(unique(categories), function(cat) {
  df_data[, categories == cat, drop = FALSE]
})

df_list_meta <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  df %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_f %>% select(SampleID, sex, month_n),
      by = "SampleID"
    )
})

otu_cols <- function(df) {
  setdiff(names(df), c("SampleID", "month", "month_n", "sex"))
}

summary_list <- imap(df_list_meta, ~ {
  .x %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(otu_cols(.x)),
      names_to = "OTU",
      values_to = "rel_abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(rel_abundance = as.numeric(rel_abundance)) %>%
    group_by(month_n, sex) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(rel_abundance)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(category = .y)
})

plot_list <- imap(summary_list, ~ {
  dfp <- .x %>%
    mutate(month_n = as.numeric(as.character(month_n))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(month_n), is.finite(mean_abundance))

  ggplot(dfp, aes(x = month_n, y = mean_abundance, color = sex)) +
    geom_smooth() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Category:", .y),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Mean relative abundance"
    ) + scale_color_manual(values=c("deeppink","#3639ff"))
})

plot_list[[1]]
```

```{r}
df1<-read_excel("output_MT_F1-refYMM-MAged_FMT/subset_results.xlsx")
df1<-merge(df1,tdf_maa, by="ASV")
norm_table<-otu_table(fmt_norm)
norm_table<-as.data.frame(norm_table)
norm_table$ASV<-rownames(norm_table)
df2<-merge(df1,norm_table,by="ASV")
df2<-df2[-c(2:8)]
df2_long <- df2 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )
metadata_fmt<-read.delim("MT_MAmice_metadata_v3.txt")
df2_long<-merge(df2_long,metadata_fmt,by="SampleID")

df2_long<-filter(df2_long, df2_long$MT != "AFM2")

df2_long<-filter(df2_long, df2_long$age_type == "D_middle_aged")

ggplot(df2_long, aes(x = MT, y = abundance, fill = MT)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ ASV, scales = "free_y")

```
```{r}
df2_long_avg <- df2_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, MT) %>%
  summarise(mean_rel = mean(abundance), .groups = "drop") #%>%
 
   mutate(MT_sex = paste(MT, sex, sep = "_"))

mat <- df2_long_avg %>%
  select(ASV, MT, mean_rel) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ASV,
    names_from = MT,
    values_from = mean_rel,
    values_fill = list(mean_rel = 0)
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix()
pheatmap::pheatmap(log10(mat + 1e-6), scale = "row", cluster_rows = FALSE)
```
